decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason:
The application to vary Condition 54 (Two bedroom affordable units (three-person versus four-person)) of approved planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 8/12/06 by replacing "?no development above natural ground level (and for the avoidance of doubt natural ground level shall not include the podium deck and basement car park) shall take place?" with "?no development above the podium deck shall take place?" would not affect the intention of the condition as imposed, subject to amendment including reference to drawings showing the extent of the podium deck in plan and section, in that details of the affordable residential accommodation would still need to be submitted before any development above the podium deck commences.

Replacement condition:
"Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above natural ground level or podium deck, whichever as applicable as shown on drawing A1944 Z 1111 P1 (Extent of Podium Deck) and the drawing entitled 'North Brentford Quarter - Plan 6 - Podium Deck Section', shall take place (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing by the Local Planning Authority) until floor plans for the affordable residential accommodation hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval."
description:
Variation of Condition 54 of approved planning permission reference 00505/P/P59 dated 08/12/06 to read as follows:

"Notwithstanding Condition 2 above, no development above the podium deck shall take place (unless otherwise agreed, in advance and in writing by the Local Planning Authority) until floor plans for the affordable residential accommodation hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and development not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
